definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.166) 'One or more runtime modules that interact with one another and that function, at execution time, as an entity'; §2023:3.158 rewords it ('runtime entity ... independent entity'). The same entity; storage persists to run unit termination in both.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:14.5.2.1.2.1 (initial state), 14.5.3 (transfers of control) and 14.5.10 (normal run unit termination); 2002 14.5.3 says 'paragraph' where 2023 says 'procedure', 2002 14.5.10 has the MCS purge item and lacks COMMIT and dynamic-table items, 2002 initial state also initializes the communication section. The rule's end point is §2002:14.5.10 item 3 (ALLOCATE storage released), word-identical to 2023 14.6.11 item 3; the items that differ (MCS purge, COMMIT, dynamic tables) are not this rule's, and 14.5.2.1.2.1 item 4 (based address null) is about initial state. No change; the reader's allocate_2002.cob stands.
